groups.activity: Disruption; let the Ghoul Eruption conduit break, then keep farming without finishing the round
groups.meta: ~30 min for a full set, with Tonkkatt too
conditions: Tak & Lug drops only from Ghoul Auger and Ghoul Devourer — Ghoul Expired drops Tonkkatt parts instead, despite older posts (and DE's own event forum post) pairing it with Devourer and Expired.
Ghouls can spawn mixed into a normal Grineer crowd and look like regular enemies at a glance; check kills closely so you don't miss them.
MR 9 is required to equip and level it; you can build it earlier, but it gives no Mastery until then.
bonuses: Tonkkatt's parts drop from the other Ghoul types in the same mission, so farm both together.
You also pick up Meso and Lith relics from the Disruption rotations while you wait.
Ghoul Purge bounties in Cetus and the Plains of Eidolon also spawn these Ghouls if Olympus isn't convenient, though at lower density.

disclosures.title: the Ghoul Eruption trick
disclosures.body: One of Olympus Disruption's conduit debuffs is 'Ghoul Eruption', which pulls Ghouls out of the ground. When it rolls, let the enemy destroy that conduit on purpose and keep farming without finishing the round — the Ghouls keep spawning. Bring Nekros with a Slash weapon; Desecrate gives dead enemies an extra loot roll at this 1.25% rate.
